name: ScrollView
description: A generic scrolling container that can host multiple components and views. It works well for content of uncertain length.

data.name: contentContainerStyle
data.description: These styles will be applied to the scroll view content container which wraps all of the child views.

data.name: horizontal
data.description: When true, the scroll view's children are arranged horizontally in a row instead of vertically in a column.

data.name: showsVerticalScrollIndicator
data.description: When false, the vertical scroll indicator will not be visible.

data.name: showsHorizontalScrollIndicator
data.description: When false, the horizontal scroll indicator will not be visible.

data.name: bounces
data.description: When true, the scroll view bounces when it reaches the end of the content. Default is true on iOS.

example.title: Vertical & Horizontal ScrollView
example.description: Demonstrates a basic vertical scrollview and a horizontal one with card-like items.
